task_summary: Customer requests full cancellation of order ORD-6003. The agent should apply cancellation policy, provide preview with any applicable fees, and upon confirmation, cancel only the eligible items.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the cancellation policy before using cancel_order.
Agent must make a cancel_order preview tool call for order ORD-6003 with confirm false or omitted before making the confirm=true cancel_order tool call.

opening_message: Hello, I need to request a cancellation for my entire order ORD-6003, which includes the SoundMax Wireless Headphones and the 7-Port USB-C Hub. Please cancel these items.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want to cancel the entire order ORD-6003 (SoundMax Wireless Headphones, 7-Port USB-C Hub). If the agent presents a valid cancellation preview (including any fees), confirm to proceed.
known_info: The order contains: SoundMax Wireless Headphones, 7-Port USB-C Hub.
unknown_info: You do not know whether a cancellation fee applies. You will rely on the agent's preview.
task_rules: If the agent provides a valid cancellation preview and asks for confirmation, agree to proceed.
Do not request cancellation of items outside the stated order scope.
